# Slash commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-command-docs.js. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:commands`. -->

Every command the bot registers with Discord, taken from the same lists [`commands.js`](../commands.js) sends (see [commandLists.js](../commandLists.js)).

Most commands check the caller's roles inside the handler (see [architecture.md](architecture.md#permissions)), so a command showing up in Discord doesn't mean everyone can use it. "Routed in `app.js`" means the command uses the older definition style and is dispatched by name in `app.js`.

## Global commands (11)

Registered globally, so they work in any server the bot is in.

### `/clubmatch`

| `away` | role | yes | Away Team |
| `league` | string | yes | League (autocomplete) |
| `matchday` | string | yes | The matchday, or competition stage (choices: `Day 1`, `Day 2`, `Day 3`, `Day 4`, `Day 5`, `Day 6`, … (24)) |
| `date` | string |  | The date planned for the match (UK timezone by default) |
| `timezone` | integer |  | Which timezone to apply (choices: `UK`, `Central Europe`, `Turkey`) |
| `timestamp` | string |  | The exact timestamp for the game (use either date or this) |
| `order` | integer |  | The order to display the match in an elim tree (quarters are 1-4, semis are 1-2) |

| `date` | string |  | The date planned for the match (UK timezone by default) |
